# Lumen

> Lumen is a two-sided video-course marketplace and a full-stack portfolio project. Instructors publish video courses; students buy them one at a time through Stripe Checkout and watch them with saved progress, reviews and comments. Payments run in Stripe test mode: nobody is ever charged.

The pages are rendered in the browser (a React single-page app), so the public data is also available as JSON from the API listed below.

## Pages

- [Home](/): the most popular courses
- [Browse courses](/courses): every course, with search, filters and sorting
- Course page: `/courses/{id}`, with its lessons, the free preview lesson, price and reviews
- Instructor page: `/sellers/{id}`, with the instructor's courses and rating
- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): every course and instructor page

## Public API (JSON, no sign-in)

- `/api/courses/all?limit=12&sort=popular`: course list (also `sort=newest`, `top_rated`, `price_asc`, `price_desc`)
- `/api/courses/{id}/public`: one course with its lessons
- `/api/courses/{id}/reviews`: a course's reviews
- `/api/public/sellers/{id}`: an instructor and their courses

## Try it

The login page shows a demo student and a demo instructor account, and Stripe's test card (4242 4242 4242 4242).

## About the project

- [Source code and README](https://github.com/DidierDankan/course-platform): architecture, decisions and trade-offs, security, tests
- Stack: React 19, Vite, Redux Toolkit, Express 5, MySQL 8.4, Stripe Checkout, Vitest + Supertest
